diff --git a/config/syslog/syslogconf_test.go b/config/syslog/syslogconf_test.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..03edc2a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/config/syslog/syslogconf_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,88 @@
+//go:build !windows
+
+package syslog
+
+import "testing"
+
+func TestConfValidate(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		name       string
+		conf       Conf
+		wantErrors int
+		wantPort   string
+	}{
+		{
+			name:     "disabled ignores invalid values",
+			conf:     Conf{Protocol: "invalid", Port: "invalid", Severity: "invalid", Facility: "invalid"},
+			wantPort: "invalid",
+		},
+		{
+			name:     "defaults",
+			conf:     Conf{Enabled: true},
+			wantPort: "514",
+		},
+		{
+			name:     "tcp",
+			conf:     Conf{Enabled: true, Protocol: "tcp", Port: "5140"},
+			wantPort: "5140",
+		},
+		{
+			name:     "udp with severity and facility",
+			conf:     Conf{Enabled: true, Protocol: "udp", Port: "12345", Severity: "emerg", Facility: "user"},
+			wantPort: "12345",
+		},
+		{
+			name:       "protocol",
+			conf:       Conf{Enabled: true, Protocol: "foo", Port: "514"},
+			wantErrors: 1,
+			wantPort:   "514",
+		},
+		{
+			name:       "port",
+			conf:       Conf{Enabled: true, Port: "-1"},
+			wantErrors: 1,
+			wantPort:   "-1",
+		},
+		{
+			name:       "severity",
+			conf:       Conf{Enabled: true, Port: "514", Severity: "invalid"},
+			wantErrors: 1,
+			wantPort:   "514",
+		},
+		{
+			name:       "facility",
+			conf:       Conf{Enabled: true, Port: "514", Facility: "invalid"},
+			wantErrors: 1,
+			wantPort:   "514",
+		},
+		{
+			name:       "protocol and port",
+			conf:       Conf{Enabled: true, Protocol: "invalid", Port: "-1"},
+			wantErrors: 2,
+			wantPort:   "-1",
+		},
+		{
+			name:       "all core fields",
+			conf:       Conf{Enabled: true, Protocol: "invalid", Port: "invalid", Severity: "invalid", Facility: "invalid"},
+			wantErrors: 4,
+			wantPort:   "invalid",
+		},
+		{
+			name:       "host",
+			conf:       Conf{Enabled: true, Host: "bad host", Port: "514"},
+			wantErrors: 1,
+			wantPort:   "514",
+		},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			if errs := tt.conf.Validate(); len(errs) != tt.wantErrors {
+				t.Errorf("Validate() returned %d errors, want %d: %v", len(errs), tt.wantErrors, errs)
+			}
+			if tt.conf.Port != tt.wantPort {
+				t.Errorf("Port = %q, want %q", tt.conf.Port, tt.wantPort)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+//go:build windows
+
+package syslog
+
+import "golang.org/x/xerrors"
+
+// Validate rejects enabled syslog reporting on Windows.
+func (c *Conf) Validate() []error {
+	if c.Enabled {
+		return []error{xerrors.New("windows not support syslog")}
+	}
+	return nil
+}

--- /dev/null
+++ b/config/syslog/syslogconf_windows_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+//go:build windows
+
+package syslog
+
+import "testing"
+
+func TestConfValidate(t *testing.T) {
+	if errs := (&Conf{Protocol: "invalid", Enabled: false}).Validate(); errs != nil {
+		t.Errorf("disabled syslog returned %v, want nil", errs)
+	}
+	if errs := (&Conf{Enabled: true}).Validate(); len(errs) != 1 || errs[0].Error() != "windows not support syslog" {
+		t.Errorf("enabled syslog returned %v, want one unsupported error", errs)
+	}
+}
